# Issue & PR Templates (`.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE`)

GitHub automatically uses the templates in this folder when contributors open
issues and pull requests. Keep this folder under `.github/` — GitHub expects it
there.

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `task.md` | Default template for a work item / task issue. |
| `pull_request_template.md` | Default body shown when opening a pull request. |

To adjust how new issues/PRs are pre-filled, edit these files. See the parent
[`.github/README.md`](../README.md).
